titulo: Plusquamperfekt: nachdem and bevor: The Plusquamperfekt

aula.objetivo: Form the Plusquamperfekt (hatte/war + Partizip II), use it for a past that came before another past, and combine it with nachdem and bevor.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: the PLUSQUAMPERFEKT is the "past of the past": it tells something that happened BEFORE another past event — the English past perfect ("I had eaten"). STEP 2: form: Präteritum of «haben» or «sein» (hatte / war) + Partizip II at the end: «Ich hatte gegessen» (I had eaten), «Er war gegangen» (he had left). STEP 3: the choice of haben/sein is the same as in the Perfekt: «ich hatte gearbeitet», «ich war gefahren». English always uses "had"; German uses «war» with verbs of movement and change: «er war gegangen». STEP 4: conjugate: ich hatte / war, du hattest / warst, er hatte / war, wir hatten / waren, ihr hattet / wart, sie hatten / waren. STEP 5: helpful words: schon, bereits, vorher, davor, zuerst: «Als ich ankam, hatte der Film schon begonnen» (when I arrived, the movie had already started).
blocos.comparacao: English has the same tense: "I had eaten" = «Ich hatte gegessen». Two differences: German uses «war» instead of "had" with movement verbs («er war gegangen» = he had gone), and the participle goes to the end.

exemplos.ru: Als ich ankam, hatte der Film schon begonnen.
exemplos.pt: When I arrived, the movie had already started.

exemplos.ru: Ich hatte nichts gegessen und war sehr müde.
exemplos.pt: I hadn't eaten anything and I was very tired.

exemplos.ru: Er war schon gegangen, als ich kam.
exemplos.pt: He had already left when I arrived.

erros.errado: Als ich ankam, der Film hatte schon begonnen.
erros.certo: Als ich ankam, hatte der Film schon begonnen.
erros.motivo: Main clause after the subordinate clause: verb first.

blocos.enunciado: Tell 6 things you had already done before a moment in the past: «Als ich ankam, hatte … schon …»
Write 6 sentences in the passive in the Präteritum and the Perfekt.
